Consider the following reaction,


Select the incorrect statement.

options.text: It is not a disproportionation reaction
<math><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo></mrow></msup></math>  is a reducing as well as oxidising agent
is a reducing as well as oxidising agent

solution.text:
One CHO is oxidised to COO- and one CHO is reduced to CH2OH .

Thus, it is not a disproportionation reaction. It is intramolecular redox reaction. Thus, option A and B are true and is reducing as well as oxidising agent.

Thus, option D is also true and option C is incorrect.
